title: Real-ESRGAN x4plus: 2x upscale
description: Upscales a source image 2x: RealESRGAN x4plus upscales 4x and a lanczos ImageScaleBy of 0.5 brings it to twice the source's width and height, which keeps more detail than a direct 2x resize. No diffusion model and no prompt. The contract check compares twice the source's size with the task's. LoadImage drops an alpha channel, so the output is RGB.

slots.label: Source image (file name in ComfyUI's input folder)

evidence.note: The upscale chain of the section Upscale: LoadImage, UpscaleModelLoader, ImageUpscaleWithModel (upscale_model, image), SaveImage. ComfyUI's template index has no image template for an upscale model alone (utility-gan_upscaler is a video template).

evidence.source: GET http://127.0.0.1:8188/object_info, ComfyUI Desktop 0.44.0; the classes used captured in src/__tests__/architect/fixtures/object-info-desktop-0.44.0.json
evidence.note: LoadImage, UpscaleModelLoader, ImageUpscaleWithModel, ImageScaleBy (upscale_method lanczos, scale_by 0.01 to 8) and SaveImage are in the live schema; ImageScaleBy rounds width times 0.5 to the nearest pixel, exact for the 4x model's output.
